serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: It’s extra cold today, so I thought that you would enjoy a warm drink after coming back!
You: Thanks, that’s exactly what I needed. I should’ve put on a warmer jacket. 
Bot: I’m sure this tea I just prepared will warm you in no time! Here’s the cup!
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Shock
You: {{punch}}Ah! It’s hot like a mother-
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
You: Sorry about that, let me put it on the desk until it cools.
Damn, it was very hot! The handle of the cup left red marks on my hand
Bot: Is your hand alright?
You: Yeah, don’t worry about it. It will heal in time.
Bot: Sorry, I wanted to warm you so eagerly that I forgot that your weak body is not only susceptible to cold but also heat…
You: It will heal in no time.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Once again, thank you for always thinking about me. It means a lot
Bot: You can count on me!
You: What tea did you use? Because of the tariffs, it’s something of a premium commodity.
Bot: Right, the tea! To avoid tariffs they are being imported as collectable items.
You: What? That’s ridiculous…
Bot: They repackage tea that was past its expiration date in other countries and when it reaches an age over 10 years, they can sell it as a collectible.
You: Is it okay to drink something like that?
Bot: It might’ve lost some of the flavor, but it should be more or less safe to consume.
Well, ‘more or less’ will have to do…
You: I think it’s cold enough now, let me get a sip.
It’s a very weak tea, but to be honest I don’t mind it, because it’s been years since the last time I had real tea.
